protocol.physical_basis: The user's explicit near-black/gray interference crosses the entire pale-letter captcha. Constants are fixed from that requested mode before reading diagnostic results; not fitted to external or blind data.
protocol.valid_columns: any(product_tensor != 0, axes=channel,height); real resized uint8 image pixels cannot be exactly zero in every scaled channel. Exclude only right padding, include all effective image edge columns.
protocol.raw_pixels: np.rint(127.5 * (product_tensor + 1)); the product resizes uint8 RGB before float32 scaling. RGB/BGR permutation does not change max or range.
protocol.covered_column: Within a valid image column, at least one pixel has maxRGB < 128 and maxRGB-minRGB <= 16.
protocol.coverage: number of covered valid columns / number of all valid columns
protocol.selection_data: Only the fixed original train/dev records and cached be9 teacher logits.
forbidden_inputs: all old or new blind images/labels/predictions
protocol.model_changes: None in this phase. No OCR inference, training, residual application or ONNX export. Report diagnostics first; a conditional candidate requires a separate decision and frozen protocol.
